GuideHeading: Set up and use Coolify Deploy Manager
Guide1Body: Choose «Automatic SSH tunnel». Enter only the VPS IP address or hostname, without http:// or :8000. Specify your existing Linux account, SSH port (usually 22), local Windows port (usually 18000), Coolify port on VPS (usually 8000) and remote destination 127.0.0.1. The server label determines your personal EXE filename.
Guide2Body: Click «Generate dedicated SSH key». CDM creates a fresh Ed25519 key pair, separate from your administration key. The VPS setup command already embeds its public key, so copying the public key separately is unnecessary.
Guide3: 3 · Install the restricted user on the server
Guide3Body: Click «Copy VPS command» and look for «✓ Copied». In Coolify open Terminal → Servers → localhost: select the SERVER host, not an entry under Containers. Run «whoami» and «hostname» to confirm that you are on the VPS Ubuntu host. Paste and execute the entire command. If sudo requires a password, enter it there. «CDM_BOOTSTRAP_OK:<user>-cdm» indicates the script finished. A trusted administrator SSH terminal also works.
Guide4Body: Click «Verify VPS SSH host fingerprint». Compare the SHA256 fingerprint CDM shows with the fingerprint obtained directly from the server using the provided command. Accept only if they match. CDM will pin the verified SSH host key.
Guide5Body: Click «Verify restricted SSH». CDM connects as the new <user>-cdm account, opens the Coolify tunnel, checks /api/health and verifies that Linux command execution is rejected. Once verified, the wizard SSH username becomes the restricted user. Your original administrator user and keys are untouched.

Guide6Body: Open Coolify → Keys & Tokens → API Tokens and create ONE token with READ + DEPLOY, without ROOT, WRITE or READ:SENSITIVE. Paste it in the wizard. CDM makes a non-mutating API read without deploying anything. This does not yet prove the exact DEPLOY ability or exclude ROOT automatically; check permissions when creating the token.
StartWithWindowsTray: Start with Windows, minimized to the notification area
StartWithWindowsHint: Launch this personal CDM when you sign in to Windows, hidden beside the clock. Double-click the icon to open it. Only one personal clone can be registered.
V3BootstrapExplain: CDM creates a NEW Linux <user>-cdm account restricted to a Coolify tunnel. The VPS SSH administrator entered above is used only for manual setup and is never embedded as the clone's operating identity.
V3BootstrapCreated: Service account provisioned. Verify host fingerprint, then test restricted SSH.
V3RestrictedVerified: Verified: tunnel works and remote Linux shell is blocked.
V3RestrictionRequired: Create and VERIFY the new restricted CDM SSH account before saving. Old administrator keys are not accepted.
V3TokenInvalid: The token is not valid for CDM read operations. Provide a Coolify READ + DEPLOY token without ROOT, WRITE or READ:SENSITIVE.
V3ManualCommandCopyFeedback: Command copied. Paste it into Coolify → Terminal → Server (localhost), NOT a container.
V3GuideIntro: Keep this window beside the setup wizard. Follow each step without closing either window.
Guide7: 7 · Save the personal clone and open Coolify
Guide7Body: Click «Verify and create/save». CDM creates a fresh personal EXE containing only the restricted SSH private key, pinned VPS host key and API token. No migration from CDM 2.2.3. When CDM's tunnel runs, you can also open http://127.0.0.1:18000 in Chrome and sign in using your usual Coolify web credentials, independent of the Linux -cdm account.
Guide8Body: CDM displays projects, applications and RUNNING/HEALTHY states. Choose a project: it will be remembered at the next launch. Before deploying, verify the exact application and STAGING or PRODUCTION environment and confirm. Detailed build logs may be unavailable with READ+DEPLOY; CDM does not request READ:SENSITIVE.
Guide9Body: The clone contains the API token and restricted-user SSH private key. Revoke the token in Coolify → Keys & Tokens. In the VPS SERVER terminal, remove only the dedicated CDM public key from /home/<user>-cdm/.ssh/authorized_keys (or disable the -cdm account), then provision a fresh identity. Never remove your administrator SSH keys or VS Code access. API-token and SSH-key revocation are separate.
V3ManualMethodHint: Use Coolify → Terminal → Servers → localhost or your normal administrator SSH terminal. Do not paste the command in a container. No Windows SSH alias is needed.
